event.text: Have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle, or any excess hair growth on your face, chest, or body?
event.why: Hormonal acne often worsens along the jawline and lower face; signs of androgen excess would influence whether hormonal therapy versus standard acne treatment is appropriate and help assess underlying causes.
